subject: Proposed addendum: billing window & burst capacity for Q3 commit
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@wavefront.ai>, Alex Kim <akim@wavefront.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: billing window & burst capacity addendum for Q3 commit

Hi Elena / Alex —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion, I attached a short addendum that covers two changes Wavefront requested so we can align on the Q3 commit:

- Move to a calendar billing window with 30-day invoice terms (instead of monthly pro-rate) so billing aligns with your central finance calendar.
- Add a burst capacity allowance (up to +40% sustained for 72 hours) that triggers at a slightly higher per-token rate but does not require new capacity provisioning.

Key commercial highlights in the attached PDF and spreadsheet:
- Baseline monthly commit increases from 2M tokens -> 3.5M tokens (effective 2026-08-01)
- Intro quarter discount: 10% unit price discount for Aug–Oct if the new commit is executed by 2026-07-20
- Burst usage billed at 2.5x baseline unit rate, capped at $25k per month in overage unless you ask to raise the cap.

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the attached addendum (wavefront-q3-commit-addendum.pdf) and pricing sheet.
2) Confirm acceptance or list edits — procurement PO or DocuSign will follow.
3) If you want, we can lock the discount for Q3 and set the effective date to Aug 1.

Can you confirm if your procurement team prefers a DocuSign route or a PO? I can circulate the final addendum either way.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0147

Attachments: wavefront-q3-commit-addendum.pdf, rdw-pricing-q3-comparison.xlsx
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@wavefront.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <akim@wavefront.ai>, procurement@wavefront.ai
Date: 2026-07-12T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: billing window & burst capacity addendum for Q3 commit

Hi Vanessa —

Appreciate the write-up and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Billing window — We prefer calendar-month invoices with net-30. The addendum language looks OK but procurement will want the invoice alignment called out explicitly (month start/end). Can you add an explicit clause?

2) Burst capacity — the 40% / 72hr proposal is reasonable. Two asks: can the burst trigger be per-route (we only want to allow burst for inference-heavy endpoints) and can we lower the overage cap to $15k/mo for Q3 while we validate traffic?

3) Discount / ramp — procurement may request the 10% discount be phased: 7% in Aug and 10% starting Sep if usage meets the new commit. Is that acceptable?

4) DocuSign vs PO — procurement prefers a PO and a signed addendum. I’ve CC’d procurement@wavefront.ai. They’ll open the PO once the addendum text and invoice cadence are final.

If you can send a small update to the addendum (call out calendar billing dates, per-route burst flag, and temporary $15k cap), we can push the PO next week.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Product
Wavefront AI
elena.soto@wavefront.ai

On Mon, Jul 12, 2026 at 09:02 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the productive call yesterday...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Proposal: billing window & burst capacity addendum for Q3 commit (internal)

Vanessa / Marissa —

Saw Elena's notes. I’m comfortable approving a temporary $15k/mo overage cap for Q3 (we’ll monitor usage) and must sign off on per-route burst gating — technically we can gate by route with a routing tag, so add that language.

Regarding the phased discount: OK to do 7% in August and 10% from September if usage meets the commit threshold. Need to ensure the pricing sheet reflects the phased discount and the effective dates (Aug 1 start).

One more thing — procurement will likely ask for an invoice memo referencing HubSpot deal RDW-8673-Q3. Please include that in the final addendum.

If you finalize the addendum with the three edits (calendar-month clause, per-route burst flag, temporary $15k cap + phased discount language), I will authorize signature from legal for DocuSign or PO acceptance.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@wavefront.ai>, Alex Kim <akim@wavefront.ai>, procurement@wavefront.ai
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final addendum & DocuSign link (Wavefront Q3 commit)

Hi Elena / Alex / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and helpful clarifications. I’ve incorporated the requested edits into the attached addendum:

- Calendar-month billing explicitly stated (invoices issued first business day of the month covering prior calendar month) with net-30 terms.
- Burst capacity scoped per-route (routing tag: wf-inference-burst) and only applies to routes Wavefront flags in the addendum.
- Temporary overage cap lowered to $15,000/mo for Aug–Oct 2026.
- Phased discount: 7% for Aug, 10% starting Sep (conditioned on usage meeting the new commit).
- HubSpot deal reference RDW-8673-Q3 added to invoice memo language.

Attached: updated wavefront-q3-commit-addendum.pdf and a one-page pricing summary. I also generated a DocuSign envelope in case procurement prefers signature flow: https://www.docusign.net/DocID/ABC-12345. If you prefer a PO route, please send the PO to billing@redwood.ai and reference RDW-8673-Q3.

If everything looks good, procurement can either:
- Return a PO referencing the addendum, or
- Route the DocuSign link to the signatory (I can re-send to your signing contact).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if there are any remaining questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
